import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Navbar from './components/Navbar';
import CitationPanel from './components/CitationPanel';
import Home from './pages/Home';
import AskDex from './pages/AskDex';
import Pokedex from './pages/Pokedex';
import ComparePage from './pages/ComparePage';
import { fetchHealth } from './services/api';

export default function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dashboard');
  const [healthInfo, setHealthInfo] = useState(null);
  const [activeCitation, setActiveCitation] = useState(null);
  const [compareSelection, setCompareSelection] = useState([]);
  const [initialQuery, setInitialQuery] = useState('');

  const loadHealth = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchHealth();
      setHealthInfo(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Network offline:', err);
      setHealthInfo({
        status: 'disconnected',
        mongodb: { connected: false, error: err.message },
      });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadHealth();
    const interval = setInterval(loadHealth, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const handleSelectForCompare = (pokemon) => {
    setCompareSelection((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.some((p) => p.id === pokemon.id);
      if (exists) {
        return prev.filter((p) => p.id !== pokemon.id);
      }
      if (prev.length >= 2) {
        return [prev[1], pokemon];
      }
      return [...prev, pokemon];
    });
  };

  const handleSelectPrompt = (prompt) => {
    setInitialQuery(prompt);
    setActiveTab('ask');
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#060b19] text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-yellow-400/30 selection:text-yellow-200 bg-grid-pattern">
      {/* Top Floating / Blurred Navigation */}
      <Navbar
        activeTab={activeTab}
        setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
        healthInfo={healthInfo}
        onQuickSearch={() => setActiveTab('pokedex')}
      />

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-4">
        {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
          <Home
            healthInfo={healthInfo}
            refreshHealth={loadHealth}
            setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
            onSelectPrompt={handleSelectPrompt}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'ask' && (
          <AskDex
            initialQuery={initialQuery}
            onCitationClick={(source) => setActiveCitation(source)}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'pokedex' && (
          <Pokedex
            onSelectForCompare={handleSelectForCompare}
            compareSelection={compareSelection}
            setActiveTab={setActiveTab}
            onAskAboutPokemon={(p) => {
              setInitialQuery(`Tell me about ${p.name}, its stats, and best battle strategies.`);
              setActiveTab('ask');
            }}
          />
        )}

        {activeTab === 'compare' && (
          <ComparePage
            compareSelection={compareSelection}
            onCitationClick={(source) => setActiveCitation(source)}
          />
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Global Citation Inspection Modal */}
      <CitationPanel
        source={activeCitation}
        onClose={() => setActiveCitation(null)}
      />

      {/* Official League Footer */}
      <footer className="border-t border-blue-500/15 py-6 mt-auto bg-[#060b19]">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-blue-300/70 font-mono">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-yellow-400 shadow-xs shadow-yellow-400" />
            <span className="text-white font-bold">DexMind</span>
            <span>â€” The Definitive National PokÃ©dex & Battle Intelligence Platform</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-blue-400/60 flex-wrap justify-center">
            <span>Gen 1 through Gen 9</span>
            <span>â€¢</span>
            <span>1,025 PokÃ©mon Registered</span>
            <span>â€¢</span>
            <span>PokÃ©mon Â© Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc.</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { X, ExternalLink, FileText, Bookmark, Info, Copy, Check } from 'lucide-react';

export default function CitationPanel({ source, onClose }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && onClose) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  if (!source) return null;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (!source.content) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(source.content);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to copy', e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        {/* Backdrop */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          onClick={onClose}
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-[#060b19]/80 backdrop-blur-md"
        />

        {/* Modal Dialog */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 450, damping: 30 }}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0b142b] border border-blue-500/25 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[85vh] z-10"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="bg-[#0f1d38] px-6 py-4 border-b border-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="bg-yellow-400/15 text-yellow-300 border border-yellow-400/40 text-xs font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md">
                {source.citation_tag || 'SOURCE'}
              </span>
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-white capitalize leading-tight">
                  {source.pokemon_name} Battle Record
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-blue-300">
                  Official Field Research Document
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="text-blue-300 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Close (Esc)"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Modal Body */}
          <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 text-sm">
            {/* Metadata Badges */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-[#060b19] p-4 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/15">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-300 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1 font-bold">
                  Record Category
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-blue-200 font-mono text-xs">
                  <Bookmark className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" />
                  {source.content_type?.replace('_', ' ') || 'General Lore'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-300 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1 font-bold">
                  Canon Source
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 text-blue-200 font-mono text-xs capitalize">
                  <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-400" />

              </div>

                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" />
                  Exact Field Research Citation:
                </span>

                  onClick={handleCopy}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] hover:text-white text-blue-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"

                      <span className="text-emerald-400">Copied</span>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Plus, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { getTypeStyle } from '../utils/pokemonTypes';

export default function PokemonCard({
  pokemon,
  onClick,
  onSelectCompare,
  isSelectedForCompare,
}) {
  const formatId = (id) => `#${String(id).padStart(3, '0')}`;
  const [imgSrc, setImgSrc] = useState(
    pokemon.sprite_url ||
    `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/${pokemon.id}.png`
  );

  const primaryType = pokemon.types?.[0]
    ? typeof pokemon.types[0] === 'string'
      ? pokemon.types[0]
      : pokemon.types[0].name
    : 'normal';

  const typeMeta = getTypeStyle(primaryType);

  return (
    <motion.div
      whileHover={{ y: -4, transition: { duration: 0.15, ease: 'easeOut' } }}
      onClick={() => onClick && onClick(pokemon)}
      className="group relative bg-[#0b142b] hover:bg-[#101e3d] border border-blue-500/15 hover:border-yellow-400/50 rounded-2xl p-4 transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col items-center cursor-pointer shadow-lg hover:shadow-yellow-400/10 overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Background Radial Glow based on PokÃ©mon's primary type */}
      <div
        className="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-32 h-32 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-300 opacity-25 group-hover:opacity-60"
        style={{ backgroundColor: typeMeta.glow }}
      />

      {/* Top Bar: ID and Compare Toggle */}
      <div className="w-full flex justify-between items-center z-10 mb-1">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-300 group-hover:text-yellow-400 transition-colors">
          {formatId(pokemon.id)}
        </span>

        {onSelectCompare && (
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onSelectCompare(pokemon);
            }}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
              isSelectedForCompare
                ? 'bg-yellow-400 border-yellow-400 text-slate-950 shadow-xs'
                : 'bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-blue-600/20'
            }`}
            title={isSelectedForCompare ? 'Remove from Matchup Lab' : 'Add to Matchup Lab'}
          >
            {isSelectedForCompare ? (
              <>
                <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-950 stroke-[3]" />
                <span>Selected</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-300 group-hover:text-yellow-400" />
                <span>Compare</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Sprite Presentation with subtle hover zoom */}
      <div className="w-28 h-28 flex items-center justify-center my-2 relative z-10">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-radial from-white/[0.04] to-transparent rounded-full" />
        <img
          src={imgSrc}
          alt={pokemon.name}
          loading="eager"
          decoding="sync"
          onError={() => {
            setImgSrc(`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/${pokemon.id}.png`);
          }}
          className="w-24 h-24 object-contain transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110 drop-shadow-md select-none"

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Send,
  User,
  Sparkles,
  BookOpen,
  AlertTriangle,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Copy,
  Check,
  RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { askQuestion } from '../services/api';

const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
  'Who counters Charizard in battle?',
  'Which types can Pikachu beat easily?',
  'Compare Greninja and Lucario.',
  'Build me a 3-PokÃ©mon team to beat Garchomp, Charizard, and Tinkaton.',
  "Explain Eevee's evolution branches.",
  'Who voiced Pikachu in the anime?' // Unanswerable test case
];

function FormattedMessage({ text, sources, onCitationClick }) {
  if (!text) return null;

  const renderWithCitations = (children) => {
    if (typeof children !== 'string') return children;
    const parts = children.split(/(\[S\d+\])/g);
    return parts.map((part, index) => {
      const match = part.match(/\[S(\d+)\]/);
      if (match) {
        const citationTag = part;
        const sourceObj = sources?.find((s) => s.citation_tag === citationTag);
        return (
          <button
            key={index}
            onClick={() => sourceObj && onCitationClick && onCitationClick(sourceObj)}
            className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.2 mx-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-yellow-400/15 hover:bg-yellow-400/30 border border-yellow-400/40 text-yellow-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer align-baseline"
            title={`View battle lore: ${sourceObj?.pokemon_name || 'source'}`}
          >
            {citationTag}
          </button>
        );
      }
      return part;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-blue-100">
      <ReactMarkdown
        components={{
          p: ({ children }) => (
            <p className="mb-2.5 last:mb-0 leading-relaxed text-blue-100/90">
              {React.Children.map(children, renderWithCitations)}
            </p>
          ),
          li: ({ children }) => (
            <li className="my-1.5 leading-relaxed list-disc ml-5 text-blue-200/90">
              {React.Children.map(children, renderWithCitations)}
            </li>
          ),
          strong: ({ children }) => (
            <strong className="font-extrabold text-white">
              {children}
            </strong>
          ),
          em: ({ children }) => (
            <em className="italic text-yellow-300/90">{children}</em>
          ),
          h3: ({ children }) => (
            <h3 className="text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-yellow-400 font-bold mt-4 mb-2">
              {children}
            </h3>
          ),
          h4: ({ children }) => (
            <h4 className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-bold mt-3 mb-1.5">
              {children}
            </h4>
          ),
          ul: ({ children }) => <ul className="space-y-1 my-2">{children}</ul>,
        }}
      >
        {text}
      </ReactMarkdown>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AskDex({ onCitationClick, initialQuery }) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    {
      id: 'welcome',
      role: 'assistant',
      text: "Greetings Trainer! I am DexMind, your Battle Coach and National PokÃ©dex Intelligence. Ask me anything about PokÃ©mon base stats, competitive battle matchups, counters, abilities, or team strategies across all 9 Generations.",
      sources: [],
      is_unanswerable: false,
    },
  ]);
  const [inputQuery, setInputQuery] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [expandedSources, setExpandedSources] = useState({});
  const [copiedMsgId, setCopiedMsgId] = useState(null);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom();
  }, [messages, loading]);

  const handleSend = async (queryToSend) => {
    const query = (queryToSend || inputQuery).trim();
    if (!query || loading) return;

    const userMessage = {
      id: `u-${Date.now()}`,
      role: 'user',
      text: query,
    };

    // Extract recent conversation history for context memory (last 6 valid turns)
    const historyPayload = messages
      .filter((m) => m.id !== 'welcome' && !m.is_error && m.text)
      .slice(-6)
      .map((m) => ({
        role: m.role,
        text: m.text,
      }));

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMessage]);
    setInputQuery('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const data = await askQuestion(query, null, historyPayload);

      const botMessage = {
        id: `a-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: data.answer,
        sources: data.sources || [],
        is_unanswerable: data.is_unanswerable,
        retrieval_meta: data.retrieval_meta,
      };

      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, botMessage]);
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = {
        id: `err-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        text: `âš ï¸ ${err.message || 'Battle Coach archives unavailable. Please check connection and try again.'}`,
        sources: [],
        is_error: true,
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, errorMessage]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // If an initialQuery is passed (from dashboard chip), send it automatically
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialQuery && initialQuery.trim()) {
      handleSend(initialQuery);
    }
  }, [initialQuery]);

  const handleClearChat = () => {
    setMessages([
      {
        id: 'welcome',
        role: 'assistant',
        text: "Battle session reset. Memory cleared. What PokÃ©mon matchup or team strategy would you like to explore next?",
        sources: [],
        is_unanswerable: false,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const handleCopyMessage = async (msgId, text) => {
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopiedMsgId(msgId);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedMsgId(null), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to copy message', e);
    }
  };

  const toggleSourceExpand = (msgId) => {
    setExpandedSources((prev) => ({ ...prev, [msgId]: !prev[msgId] }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-7.5rem)]">
      {/* Top Bar: Suggestions & Control */}
      <div className="py-2 border-b border-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Suggested Queries */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 text-xs no-scrollbar flex-1">
          <span className="text-blue-300 shrink-0 font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold">
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-yellow-400" /> Suggestions:
          </span>
          {SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS.map((q, idx) => (
            <button
              key={idx}
              onClick={() => handleSend(q)}
              disabled={loading}
              className="shrink-0 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#0b142b] hover:bg-[#101e3d] border border-blue-500/20 hover:border-yellow-400/40 text-blue-100 text-[11px] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {q}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Reset Chat Button */}
        {messages.length > 1 && (
          <button
            onClick={handleClearChat}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#0b142b] hover:bg-[#101e3d] border border-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-mono transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 font-semibold"
            title="Reset conversation context"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Reset Session</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Messages Scroll Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-6 space-y-6 pr-1">
        {messages.map((m) => {
          const isUser = m.role === 'user';
          return (
            <motion.div
              key={m.id}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
              className={`flex gap-3.5 ${isUser ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
            >
              {/* Bot Avatar */}
              {!isUser && (
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-400 via-amber-500 to-blue-600 p-0.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5 shadow-md shadow-yellow-400/20">
                  <div className="w-full h-full rounded-full bg-[#060b19] flex items-center justify-center">
                    <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-400 shadow-xs animate-pulse-subtle" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Message Bubble */}
              <div
                className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed relative group ${
                  isUser
                    ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-500 text-white rounded-tr-xs shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 font-medium'
                    : m.is_error
                    ? 'bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 rounded-tl-xs'
                    : 'bg-[#0b142b] border border-blue-500/20 text-slate-100 rounded-tl-xs shadow-xl'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Out of Scope Lore Banner */}
                {m.is_unanswerable && (
                  <div className="mb-3.5 p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-200 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Topic Outside Game Battle Records & PokÃ©dex Lore</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Formatted Message Body */}
                {isUser ? (
                  <div className="whitespace-pre-line font-medium">{m.text}</div>
                ) : (
                  <FormattedMessage
                    text={m.text}
                    sources={m.sources}
                    onCitationClick={onCitationClick}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Actions Footer for Bot Messages */}
                {!isUser && !m.is_error && (

=== FILE: E:\MDB\frontend\src\pages\ComparePage.jsx ===

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowUpDown, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, Sparkles, Swords } from 'lucide-react';
import { comparePokemon, fetchPokemonList } from '../services/api';
import ComparisonCard from '../components/ComparisonCard';

const COMPARISON_PRESETS = [
  { p1: 'Charizard', p2: 'Blastoise' },
  { p1: 'Lucario', p2: 'Greninja' },
  { p1: 'Garchomp', p2: 'Dragonite' },
  { p1: 'Tinkaton', p2: 'Gengar' },
  { p1: 'Pikachu', p2: 'Raichu' },
];

export default function ComparePage({ compareSelection, onCitationClick }) {
  const [allPokemon, setAllPokemon] = useState([]);
  const [p1Name, setP1Name] = useState(compareSelection?.[0]?.name || 'Charizard');
  const [p2Name, setP2Name] = useState(compareSelection?.[1]?.name || 'Blastoise');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [comparisonData, setComparisonData] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  // Fetch list of available PokÃ©mon for autocomplete
  useEffect(() => {
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetchPokemonList();
        setAllPokemon(res.results || []);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to load PokÃ©mon list for comparison autocomplete:', e);
      }
    };
    load();
  }, []);

  // Update names if compareSelection changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    if (compareSelection && compareSelection.length > 0) {
      if (compareSelection[0]) setP1Name(compareSelection[0].name);
      if (compareSelection[1]) setP2Name(compareSelection[1].name);
    }
  }, [compareSelection]);

  const executeComparison = async (pokemonA, pokemonB) => {
    const a = (pokemonA || p1Name).trim();
    const b = (pokemonB || p2Name).trim();
    if (!a || !b) return;

    setError('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await comparePokemon(a, b);
      setComparisonData(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || 'Comparison failed.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSwap = () => {
    const temp = p1Name;
    setP1Name(p2Name);
    setP2Name(temp);
  };

  const handlePresetClick = (preset) => {
    setP1Name(preset.p1);
    setP2Name(preset.p2);
    executeComparison(preset.p1, preset.p2);
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto py-2 space-y-8">
      {/* Selector Box */}
      <div className="bg-[#0b142b] border border-blue-500/20 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
        {/* Glow accent */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-yellow-400/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-6">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-400/15 border border-yellow-400/30 text-yellow-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold mb-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" />
              Official League Matchup Simulator
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              <Swords className="w-6 h-6 text-yellow-400" />
              <span>Head-to-Head Battle Lab</span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-blue-200/80 mt-1 max-w-lg">
              Simulate head-to-head tactical matchups between any two PokÃ©mon across all 9 Generations with stat differential analysis, type coverage calculations, and battle coach verdicts.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Preset Buttons */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 items-center">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-300 uppercase font-bold">Presets:</span>
            {COMPARISON_PRESETS.slice(0, 3).map((preset, idx) => (
              <button
                key={idx}
                onClick={() => handlePresetClick(preset)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#060b19] hover:bg-[#162850] border border-blue-500/20 text-[11px] font-mono text-blue-200 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer font-semibold"
              >
                {preset.p1} vs {preset.p2}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Input Controls */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3 items-end">
          {/* Pokemon 1 Selector */}
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-blue-300 mb-1.5 font-bold">
              First Combatant
            </label>
            <input
              list="pokemon-list-1"
              value={p1Name}
              onChange={(e) => setP1Name(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Charizard"
              className="w-full bg-[#060b19] border border-blue-500/25 focus:border-yellow-400 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white capitalize font-semibold placeholder-blue-300/40 focus:outline-hidden transition-all shadow-inner"
            />
            <datalist id="pokemon-list-1">
              {allPokemon.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.name} />
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>

          {/* Swap Button */}
          <div className="text-center sm:col-span-1 flex justify-center pb-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSwap}
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#060b19] hover:bg-[#162850] border border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-yellow-400 hover:text-yellow-300 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              title="Swap PokÃ©mon"
            >
              <ArrowUpDown className="w-4 h-4 stroke-[2.5]" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Pokemon 2 Selector */}
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-mono text-blue-300 mb-1.5 font-bold">
              Opponent PokÃ©mon
            </label>
            <input
              list="pokemon-list-2"
              value={p2Name}
              onChange={(e) => setP2Name(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Blastoise"
              className="w-full bg-[#060b19] border border-blue-500/25 focus:border-yellow-400 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white capitalize font-semibold placeholder-blue-300/40 focus:outline-hidden transition-all shadow-inner"
            />
            <datalist id="pokemon-list-2">
              {allPokemon.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.name} />
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Button */}
        <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={() => executeComparison()}
            disabled={loading || !p1Name.trim() || !p2Name.trim()}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              loading || !p1Name.trim() || !p2Name.trim()
                ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 to-amber-400 hover:from-yellow-300 hover:to-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black shadow-lg shadow-yellow-400/25'
            }`}
          >
            {loading ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-slate-950" />
                Simulating Matchup...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Swords className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-950 stroke-[2.5]" />
                Simulate Head-to-Head Battle
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Error Alert */}
        {error && (
          <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-xl bg-red-950/40 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 text-xs flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Comparison Results Card */}
      {comparisonData && (
        <ComparisonCard
          data={comparisonData}
          onCitationClick={onCitationClick}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

} from 'lucide-react';

import PokemonCard from '../components/PokemonCard';
import { getTypeStyle } from '../utils/pokemonTypes';

  { id: 3, label: 'Gen 3', region: 'Hoenn', range: '252â€“386' },

  'All',

  'Water',
  'Grass',
  'Electric',
  'Ice',

  attack: { name: 'Attack', icon: Zap, max: 255 },

export default function Pokedex({
  onSelectForCompare,
  compareSelection,
  setActiveTab,
  onAskAboutPokemon,
}) {
  const [pokemonList, setPokemonList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState('All');
  const [selectedGen, setSelectedGen] = useState('All');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(48);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [selectedPokemon, setSelectedPokemon] = useState(null);

  const searchInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Keyboard shortcut listener: press '/' to focus search
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === '/' && document.activeElement !== searchInputRef.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
        searchInputRef.current?.focus();
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && selectedPokemon) {
        setSelectedPokemon(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [selectedPokemon]);

  // Reset to page 1 on filter or search changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [selectedGen, selectedType, searchTerm, pageSize]);

  const loadPokemon = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const typeFilter = selectedType === 'All' ? null : selectedType;
      const genFilter = selectedGen === 'All' ? null : Number(selectedGen);
      const res = await fetchPokemonList({
        search: searchTerm.trim() || null,
        type: typeFilter,
        generation: genFilter,
        page: currentPage,
        limit: pageSize,
      });

      const list = res.results || [];
      setPokemonList(list);
      setTotalCount(res.count ?? list.length);
      setTotalPages(res.total_pages || Math.max(1, Math.ceil((res.count || list.length) / pageSize)));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load PokÃ©mon', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      loadPokemon();
    }, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
  }, [selectedGen, selectedType, searchTerm, currentPage, pageSize]);

  const handleCardClick = async (p) => {
    setSelectedPokemon(p);
    try {
      const detail = await fetchPokemonDetail(p.id);
      setSelectedPokemon(detail);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load PokÃ©mon detail', err);
    }
  };

  const handlePageChange = (page) => {
    if (page < 1 || page > totalPages || page === currentPage) return;

      const end = Math.min(totalPages - 1, currentPage + 1);
      for (let i = start; i <= end; i++) pages.push(i);
      if (currentPage < totalPages - 2) pages.push('...');
      pages.push(totalPages);

            />

                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPokemon(null)}
                  className="text-blue-300 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/[0.06] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Close (Esc)"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Modal Body */}
              <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 text-sm">
                {/* Hero Showcase */}
                <div className="relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-6 bg-[#060b19] p-5 rounded-2xl border border-blue-500/20">
                  <div
                    className="absolute -top-12 -left-12 w-32 h-32 rounded-full blur-2xl pointer-events-none opacity-40"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: modalTypeStyle.glow }}
                  />

                  <img
                    src={selectedPokemon.sprite_url}
                    alt={selectedPokemon.name}
                    className="w-32 h-32 object-contain drop-shadow-lg relative z-10 select-none"
                  />
                  <div className="flex-1 space-y-2.5 text-center sm:text-left relative z-10">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 justify-center sm:justify-start">
                      {selectedPokemon.types?.map((t) => {
                        const typeName = typeof t === 'string' ? t : t.name;
                        const style = getTypeStyle(typeName);
                        return (
                          <span
                            key={typeName}
                            className={`text-xs font-bold uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md tracking-wider border ${style.bg} ${style.border} ${style.text}`}
                          >
                            {typeName}
                          </span>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono text-blue-200/80 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                      <div>
                        Height:{' '}
                        <span className="text-white font-bold">
                          {selectedPokemon.height || 'N/A'} m
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        Weight:{' '}
                        <span className="text-white font-bold">
                          {selectedPokemon.weight || 'N/A'} kg
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Base Stats with Animated Progress Bars */}
                {selectedPokemon.stats && (
                  <div className="space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h4 className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-bold">
                        Base Statistics
                      </h4>
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-blue-200">
                        Total BST:{' '}
                        <strong className="text-yellow-400 font-black">
                          {selectedPokemon.stats.total || 'N/A'}
                        </strong>
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {Object.entries(selectedPokemon.stats).map(([k, v]) => {
                        const config = STAT_CONFIG[k] || { name: k, max: 255 };
                        const pct = Math.min(Math.round((v / config.max) * 100), 100);
                        const isHigh = v >= 100;
                        const isMid = v >= 70 && v < 100;

                        return (
                          <div
                            key={k}
                            className="bg-[#060b19] p-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/15 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs font-mono"
                          >
                            <span className="w-24 text-blue-300 uppercase text-[11px] truncate font-semibold">
                              {k.replace('_', ' ')}
                            </span>
                            <div className="flex-1 h-2 bg-blue-950/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                              <div
                                style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                                className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                                  isHigh
                                    ? 'bg-yellow-400'
                                    : isMid
                                    ? 'bg-blue-400'
                                    : 'bg-slate-500'
                                }`}
                              />
                            </div>
                            <span className="w-8 text-right text-white font-bold">{v}</span>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Evolution Chain */}
                {selectedPokemon.evolution_text && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-bold mb-1.5">
                      Evolution Chain
                    </h4>
                    <p className="bg-[#060b19] p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/15 text-xs text-blue-100/90 leading-relaxed font-sans">
                      {selectedPokemon.evolution_text}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Abilities */}
                {selectedPokemon.abilities && selectedPokemon.abilities.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 font-bold">
                      Abilities
                    </h4>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {selectedPokemon.abilities.map((ab, idx) => (
                        <div
                          key={idx}
                          className="bg-[#060b19] p-3 rounded-xl border border-blue-500/15 text-xs"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                            <span className="font-bold text-white capitalize">
                              {ab.name}
                            </span>
                            {ab.is_hidden && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] bg-yellow-400/20 border border-yellow-400/30 text-yellow-300 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-mono font-bold">
                                Hidden Ability
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-blue-200/70 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                            {ab.effect || ab.short_effect || 'No description available.'}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Footer with Actions */}
              <div className="bg-[#0f1d38] px-6 py-3.5 border-t border-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSelectForCompare(selectedPokemon);
                      setSelectedPokemon(null);
                      setActiveTab('compare');
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#060b19] hover:bg-[#162850] text-blue-200 text-xs font-bold border border-blue-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-400" />
                    Matchup Lab
                  </button>

                  {onAskAboutPokemon && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        const target = selectedPokemon;
                        setSelectedPokemon(null);
                        onAskAboutPokemon(target);
                      }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-400 to-amber-400 hover:from-yellow-300 hover:to-amber-300 text-slate-950 text-xs font-black transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-yellow-400/20"
                    >
                      <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-950" />
                      Ask Battle Coach
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPokemon(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '';

export async function fetchHealth() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/health`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Health check failed: ${res.statusText}`);
  return res.json();
}

export async function startIngestion() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/ingest/kanto`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail?.message || data.detail || 'Failed to start ingestion');
  return data;
}

export async function fetchIngestStatus() {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/ingest/status`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch status: ${res.statusText}`);
  return res.json();
}

export async function fetchPokemonList(params = {}) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (params.search) query.append('search', params.search);
  if (params.type && params.type !== 'All') query.append('type', params.type);
  if (params.generation && params.generation !== 'All') query.append('generation', params.generation);
  if (params.page) query.append('page', params.page);
  if (params.limit) query.append('limit', params.limit);

  const url = `${API_BASE}/api/pokemon${query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : ''}`;
  const res = await fetch(url);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch PokÃ©mon list: ${res.statusText}`);
  return res.json();
}

export async function fetchPokemonDetail(id) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/pokemon/${id}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch PokÃ©mon #${id}`);
  return res.json();
}

export async function askQuestion(question, filters = null, history = null) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/ask`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ question, filters, history }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorMsg = data.detail?.message || (typeof data.detail === 'string' ? data.detail : JSON.stringify(data.detail));
    const errorType = data.detail?.error_type || 'Error';
    const err = new Error(errorMsg || 'Failed to answer question');
    err.type = errorType;
    throw err;
  }
  return data;
}

export async function comparePokemon(pokemon1, pokemon2) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/compare`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ pokemon1, pokemon2 }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || 'Failed to compare PokÃ©mon');
  return data;
}

export function getTypeStyle(type) {
  const normalized = (typeof type === 'string' ? type : type?.name || '').toLowerCase();
  return TYPE_CONFIG[normalized] || {
    bg: 'bg-zinc-700/80',
    border: 'border-zinc-600/40',
    text: 'text-zinc-200',
    glow: 'rgba(161, 161, 170, 0.1)',
    gradient: 'from-zinc-700/20 to-zinc-900/10',
  };
}
